description: This file is a JavaScript module that provides a factory function for creating a Supabase client, used in a frontend React project for interacting with the Supabase backend. It includes documentation, environment variable usage, and example usage code.

methods.name: getSupabaseClient
methods.description: Returns a Supabase client initialized with environment variables REACT_APP_SUPABASE_URL and REACT_APP_SUPABASE_KEY, or defaults if they are missing. Also logs a warning if env vars are missing.
